summary: Aggregate a GeoZarr dataset to DHIS2 org units and save a named, deliverable DHIS2 export

parameters.name: dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the published GeoZarr collection to aggregate (as listed under /datasets).

parameters.name: temporal_extent
parameters.description: Time range to load as [start, end] ISO-8601 date strings.

parameters.name: geometries
parameters.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection of organisation units. Each feature's `id` must be its DHIS2 organisation unit UID.

parameters.name: export
parameters.description: ID of a named DHIS2 export declared under `exports` in the instance configuration. It supplies the data element mapping, period type, and delivery connection.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Spatial aggregation method applied to the pixels within each org unit, weighted by the area of each pixel the org unit covers: mean (default), min, max, sum, median, or majority (for categorical data; a categorical dataset uses it in place of mean, median or sum).
